source.provenance: Butterfly Conservation Europe species foodplant pages explicitly derived from Clarke (2024), DOI 10.1002/ece3.10834, retaining only evidence tiers 1-3; not an original field observation or byte-identical Dryad original.
source.limitations: No per-link evidence tier, country, primary references, or original Dryad full list of claims; cannot estimate raw evidence-tier frequency, represent all of Europe, or claim biological independence.

candidate_rule: Read exact 239 species names from pinned data/frozen/figure_sources/anthropogenic_species_metrics.csv, and BCE exact two-token binomials from the site's 501-species taxonomy table. Alphabetically sort their EXACT intersection, then take first 12 (not chosen based on HOSTS overlap). This is source/access pilot only.
fixed_hosts: Pinned globalbioticinteractions/HOSTS 808e0b869f9ec1adf8efff87cf6a395adda103e0 resource.csv; exact insect genus/species and exact plant genus/species binomials only. No implicit synonym normalization.
inclusion: Only a uniquely matched butterfly page with valid exact title and explicit Larval Foodplants table
Only species-rank plant genus + unambiguous simple species epithet; exclude genera alone, hybrids, subspecies, varieties and ambiguous epithets
Treat missing host-page table or unavailable page as NOT AUDITED, not zero confirmed hosts
metrics: Exact overlap counts, BCE-only host names and HOSTS-only names per selected butterfly
Number of plant-name pairs excluded for rank/ambiguity
Page source URLs and SHA256 hashes, download errors and pilot denominator
stop_rules: Do not generalize exact name mismatch to genuine unreported interaction: synonyms/taxonomy not fully reconciled
Do not infer historic colonization, fitness, host quality or abundance from checklist
If source site denies access, preserve error and stop
No GEB manuscript updates or 239-species summary changes from this small post-hoc pilot
